Title: <short imperative summary>

Summary
- What changed and why?

Problem
- What problem does this PR solve?

Solution
- How did you solve it? Any alternatives considered?

Testing
- How did you test this change? Include commands and results.

Screenshots (UI changes)
- Add before/after where helpful

Risks
- What could go wrong? How is this mitigated?

Rollback plan
- How would you revert or mitigate if needed?

Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated (unit/integration/UI as appropriate)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README/CLAUDE/docs)
- [ ] All tests green (pytest, Jest)
- [ ] Lint/type checks green if configured (ruff/flake8, eslint/prettier, tsc)
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data included
- [ ] Verified local dev servers as needed
